breadcrumbs.name: RFID Membership Cards — Multi-chip Hf/uhf Cards For Gym, Club And Loyalty Programs

summary: RFID membership cards combine contactless access control with loyalty program functionality in a single CR-80 card. Available with single-chip (MIFARE Classic, DESFire or NTAG), dual-chip (HF + LF) or hybrid HF/UHF configurations, these cards are designed for gyms, health clubs, co-working spaces, golf clubs and retail loyalty programs requiring both gate access and point-of-sale recognition.
